title: Kilburn Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical facilities, walk-in centres, and essential supply points for Kilburn and West Hampstead.
content:
For life-threatening medical emergencies, call 999 or 112 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead NW3 2QG. From West Hampstead station: ~25 min walk north-east via Broadhurst Gardens and Hampstead, or bus C11 east to Royal Free Hospital (~15 mins).
- St Mary's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Praed Street, London W2 1NY. From Kilburn Park station: ~10 mins south on the Bakerloo line to Paddington, or bus 16 or 98 south down Kilburn High Road and Edgware Road (~20 mins).

2. Urgent Treatment Centres
- Royal Free Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre: Pond Street, London NW3 2QG (ground floor of Royal Free Hospital).
- St Mary's Urgent Treatment Centre: Praed Street, London W2 1NY (located within St Mary's Hospital emergency wing).

3. Local Hazard Notes
- The culverted Kilburn Brook runs beneath the area, making low spots along Kilburn High Road and rail dips near Kilburn High Road station susceptible to rapid surface water flooding during heavy storms.

4. Essential Supplies
- Supermarkets and community pharmacies along Kilburn High Road and West End Lane (West Hampstead) supply water, emergency hygiene items, and medicines during outages.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
